record.paper_title: On two long standing open problems on Lp-spaces
record.original_question: Let E be an infinite-dimensional complemented subspace of L1. If E has the Schur property, meaning that weak convergence of a sequence in E always implies norm convergence, must E be isomorphic to ell1?

evidence.quote: Let E be an infinite dimensional complemented subspace of L1. Claim 1. If E has the Schur property then E is isomorphic to ell1.
As to the best of our knowledge, there is no information about Claim 1 in the literature.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L_1 = L_1[0,1]$ denote the Banach space of (equivalence classes of) Lebesgue integrable real-valued functions on $[0,1]$ with the norm $\|f\|_1 = \int_0^1 |f(t)|\,dt$. A closed subspace $E \subseteq L_1$ is said to be complemented if there exists a bounded linear projection $P: L_1 \to L_1$ with range $E$. A Banach space $E$ is said to have the Schur property if every weakly convergent sequence in $E$ is norm convergent.

Question: Let $E$ be an infinite-dimensional complemented subspace of $L_1$ that has the Schur property. Must $E$ be isomorphic (as a Banach space) to $\ell_1$?
artifact.category_tag: Banach space geometry / complemented subspaces of L1
artifact.status_search_result: The general classification of complemented subspaces of $L_1$ is a long-standing open problem; it is conjectured that they are isomorphic to $\ell_1$ or to $L_1$. No literature appears to specifically resolve the Schur-property version of the question, and recent surveys and works on complemented subspaces of $L_1$ and Banach lattices do not report a solution. The problem appears to be open.

status_evidence.title: A Survey on the Complemented Subspace Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys the complemented subspace problem; the classification of complemented subspaces of L_1 remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The classification problem for complemented subspaces of L_1 is open.

status_evidence.title: Complemented subspaces of Banach lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on complemented subspaces of Banach lattices does not report a resolution of the Schur-property variant for L_1.
status_evidence.claim: No published resolution of the specific Schur-property question for complemented subspaces of L_1 is found.
